outcome: COMPLETED — PTQ ceiling reached for INT8; evidence updated and committed
summary: Extended INT8 post-training quantization (PTQ) sweeps on both TensorRT (Jetson Orin Nano) and OpenVINO (Apple Silicon). Both targets reach their PTQ ceiling — 4/6 TensorRT gates and 4/5 OpenVINO gates pass. The remaining gaps are structural to PTQ (INT8 score compression on low-confidence detections) and cannot be closed with more calibration data, different calibrators, or precision-scope tuning. QAT (quantization-aware training) is the documented path forward.
review_caveat: All evidence is self-reviewed by the worker that built it. No independent reviewer pass was performed. Evidence is 'observed_unsigned_development' kind — not certified, not signed, not publishable.

TensorRT_INT8.breakthrough: 4th breakthrough: FLOAT (FP32) for head layers instead of FP16 reduces max_delta from 0.206 to 0.168. FP32 preserves exact score precision for the confidence head.
TensorRT_INT8.negative_finding: More calibration data (2000, 4990) made things WORSE — MinMax calibrator saturates at ~1000 images.

configs_tested: MIXED + per_channel (NNCF doesn't expose per_channel param)
MIXED + ignore Sigmoid+Softmax+Split (failed: Split/Concat can't be ignored)
accuracy_control bounded (max 50 iter, RELATIVE drop 0.05) — still too slow
OpenVINO_INT8.breakthrough: Ignoring all 88 Sigmoid + 2 Softmax operations reduces max_score_delta by 36% (0.245→0.155). Sigmoid ops are the primary source of INT8 score quantization error.

why_both_INT8_targets_are_stuck.root_cause: INT8 PTQ compresses confidence scores on low-confidence detections near the 0.25 threshold. The effect is systematic, not random — the same detections are affected across all configs.
why_both_INT8_targets_are_stuck.tensorRT_coverage_gap: 5 low-confidence detections (scores 0.27–0.43) always lost across ALL 20 configs — structural threshold-boundary effect.
why_both_INT8_targets_are_stuck.max_delta_gap: INT8 activation quantization in Conv layers feeding Sigmoid/Softmax shifts scores by 0.06–0.15 across 27 detections. This is fundamental to post-training approximation.
why_both_INT8_targets_are_stuck.what_would_fix_it: QAT (quantization-aware training) — retrain YOLO26n with simulated INT8 quantization in the training loop so the model learns robustness. Requires COCO training pipeline + GPU hours.
why_both_INT8_targets_are_stuck.why_we_stopped: Exhausted ALL practical PTQ options. 20 TensorRT configs, 14 OpenVINO configs, every calibrator/scope/augmentation combination. Effort/return is now worst. QAT is a different kind of work (training, not inference/quantization).

api_gotchas_discovered.openvino: model.ops does not exist; use model.get_ops() to enumerate operations
api_gotchas_discovered.openvino_save: core.save_model() does not exist; use save_model() imported from openvino package
api_gotchas_discovered.nncf_dataset: nncf.quantize() requires nncf.Dataset(arrays) wrapper, not a plain list
api_gotchas_discovered.nncf_accuracy_control: takes validation_fn(compiled_model, data_iter) -> (metric, None), NOT compile_fn+validate_fn; max_num_iterations bounds iterations but each iteration still needs many validations (10+); even bounded to 50 iterations it's too slow for e2e NMS graph
api_gotchas_discovered.nncf_ignored_scope: Split and Concat operations cannot be included in ignored_scope (NNCF requires them to be quantized); Sigmoid/Softmax/Conv/Mul/model.N.N work fine
api_gotchas_discovered.tensorrt_float: trt.DataType.FLOAT (stronger than HALF) for head Conv layers via OBEY_PRECISION_CONSTRAINTS gives better score fidelity than FP16
api_gotchas_discovered.tensorrt_calib_data: MinMax calibrator saturates at ~1000 calibration images; more data (2000, 4990) makes results WORSE
api_gotchas_discovered.pycocotools: COCO annotations JSON can be corrupt in this repo (instances_val2017.json); use .verified.json variant
